name: pyinit
title: Pena-Yohai initial estimator for robust regression
description: Computes the Pena-Yohai (PY) deterministic initial estimator for MM-regression. Instead of random subsampling, it builds a small set of robust candidate coefficient vectors by iteratively removing observations with high 'principal sensitivity'. RobStatTM uses these candidates as the deterministic starting points for `lmrobdetMM`. This wrapper exposes the `pyinit` routine from the companion `pyinit` package.

arguments.description: design matrix of predictors with shape (n, p); the wrapper accepts this as the keyword `X`.
whether to add an intercept column to the design matrix (default True).
proportion of candidates to keep at each principal-sensitivity-component step.
method for keeping observations by residual size: 'threshold' or 'proportion'.
proportion of observations to keep when `resid_keep_method='proportion'`.
maximum number of refinement iterations per candidate.

value.description: matrix whose columns are the candidate coefficient vectors (one robust starting point per column).
value of the robust objective for each candidate.

references: Pena, D. and Yohai, V. (1999). A fast procedure for outlier diagnostics in large regression problems. JASA 94(446), 434-445.
author: the pyinit package authors
